children: Following acquisition, Tracer Drone accelerates fleet expansion and operational readiness, with services spanning pilot certification preparation to turnkey Drone as First Responder systems.
HOBOKEN, N.J., Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
Rocket One Inc. (Nasdaq: RKTO)

("Rocket One" or the "Company"), an AI-based semiconductor infrastructure company, today announced public safety program wins at its recently acquired Tracer Drone Technologies, advancing the growth and operational readiness of drone programs across four law enforcement agencies, two sheriff's departments and two fire departments.

These wins include fleet additions and program support that help public safety organizations establish new unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) programs, expand existing operations, and prepare personnel for deployment. Following its acquisition by Rocket One, Tracer Drone has supported agencies in strengthening capabilities for missions including interior clearing and search and rescue.

"Tracer Drone is delivering tangible progress following our acquisition, helping law enforcement and fire services build and expand their drone capabilities," said Robb Knie, Chief Executive Officer of Rocket One. "These wins demonstrate the breadth of Tracer's public safety business and provide a foundation for continued growth. We intend to build on this momentum by supporting agencies from initial program planning through operational deployment and fleet expansion."
End-to-End Public Safety Drone Support

Tracer Drone serves organizations launching their first public safety drone program as well as agencies scaling established fleets. Its support ranges from FAA Part 107 study assistance to help prospective remote pilots prepare for the certification exam, through fleet development and turnkey Drone as First Responder (DFR) systems.

By supporting multiple stages of program development, Tracer Drone helps agencies address equipment needs, pilot preparation, and implementation requirements as they advance toward operational readiness.
Building Momentum Following the Acquisition
The progress across law enforcement agencies, sheriff's departments and fire departments reflects Tracer Drone's ability to support a range of public safety missions and customer needs.
Rocket One intends to build on these relationships, pursue additional agency opportunities and expand Tracer Drone's role in supporting public safety UAS programs.

"Our goal is to make Tracer Drone a long-term resource for agencies as their operational needs evolve," added Knie. "Whether an agency is starting its first program or expanding toward Drone as First Responder capabilities, we see opportunities to support its development at each stage."
About Rocket One

Rocket One Inc. is a publicly traded technology company building a portfolio across artificial intelligence infrastructure, advanced semiconductor technologies, space and defense systems, and autonomous platforms. Rocket One is advancing licensed spintronic and nanomagnetic computing technologies for AI acceleration and radiation-tolerant computing, together with Swarm Stage AI, a drone-swarm threat-emulation and counter-UAS training platform. Tracer Drone Technologies, LLC (a Rocket One company) provides end-to-end drone solutions including hardware, software, FAA training, and technical support to help public safety, commercial, and enterprise organizations successfully deploy and maintain their aerial programs.
